unit.title: Introductions
unit.goal: Introduce yourself, talk about family, numbers, and daily routines.

lessons.title: Greetings and politeness
lessons.objective: Greet people and use polite words in everyday situations.

en.title: Greetings and politeness
en.objective: Greet people and use polite words in everyday situations.

blocks.text: Use “Good morning” before noon, “Good afternoon” in the day, and “Good evening” after sunset.

items: hello — a greeting when you meet someone
good morning — a greeting before noon
good evening — a greeting after sunset
goodbye — a word said when leaving
please — a polite word when asking
thank you — words to show gratitude

items.correct: Excuse me, can I ask a question?

items: “Please” and “thank you” make requests sound natural and polite.

id.title: Sapaan dan kesopanan
id.objective: Menyapa orang dan menggunakan kata sopan dalam situasi sehari-hari.

blocks.text: Gunakan “Good morning” sebelum tengah hari, “Good afternoon” pada siang, dan “Good evening” setelah matahari terbenam.

items.correct: Excuse me, can I ask a question?

items: “Please” dan “thank you” membuat permintaan terdengar natural dan sopan.

You meet someone at 9 a.m. What do you say?

explanations.en: 9 a.m. is morning, so say “Good morning”.
explanations.id: Pukul 9 pagi adalah pagi, jadi ucapkan “Good morning”.

Which sentence has the same meaning as “Good morning, class!”?

choices.label: You greet the class in the morning.
You say goodbye and will meet again tomorrow.

explanations.en: “Good morning, class!” means “You greet the class in the morning.”.
explanations.id: “Good morning, class!” berarti “You greet the class in the morning.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “Thank you, teacher.”?

choices.label: You greet the class in the morning.
You say goodbye and will meet again tomorrow.

explanations.id: “Thank you, teacher.” berarti “You thank the teacher.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “Excuse me, can I ask a question?”?

choices.label: You greet the class in the morning.
You say goodbye and will meet again tomorrow.

explanations.en: “Excuse me, can I ask a question?” means “You politely ask for attention.”.
explanations.id: “Excuse me, can I ask a question?” berarti “You politely ask for attention.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “Goodbye, see you tomorrow.”?

choices.label: You say goodbye and will meet again tomorrow.

explanations.en: “Goodbye, see you tomorrow.” means “You say goodbye and will meet again tomorrow.”.
explanations.id: “Goodbye, see you tomorrow.” berarti “You say goodbye and will meet again tomorrow.”.

choices.label: You greet someone and introduce yourself.
You greet the class in the morning.

explanations.en: “Hello, my name is Ana.” means “You greet someone and introduce yourself.”.
explanations.id: “Hello, my name is Ana.” berarti “You greet someone and introduce yourself.”.

explanations.en: “Good morning” is the fixed morning greeting.
explanations.id: “Good morning” adalah sapaan pagi yang tetap.

lessons.title: Names, countries, and nationalities
lessons.objective: Introduce your name, country, and nationality with am/is/are.

en.title: Names, countries, and nationalities
en.objective: Introduce your name, country, and nationality with am/is/are.

blocks.text: Use am with I, is with he/she/it, and are with you/we/they.

items: name — the word people call you
country — a nation such as Indonesia
nationality — the country you belong to
friend — a person you like and know
“I am from Indonesia” uses from for origin; “I live in Jakarta” uses in for place.

id.title: Nama, negara, dan kewarganegaraan
id.objective: Memperkenalkan nama, negara, dan kewarganegaraan dengan am/is/are.

blocks.text: Gunakan am dengan I, is dengan he/she/it, dan are dengan you/we/they.

items: “I am from Indonesia” memakai from untuk asal; “I live in Jakarta” memakai in untuk tempat.

choices.label: a person you like and know

explanations.en: “friend” means “a person you like and know”.

choices.label: to have a home in a place

explanations.en: “live” means “to have a home in a place”.

choices.label: a system of words people speak

explanations.en: “language” means “a system of words people speak”.

questions.prompt: Which word means “the word people call you”?
Which word means “a nation such as Indonesia”?
Which word means “the country you belong to”?
Which word means “a person who studies”?
Which word means “a person who teaches”?

explanations.en: “Where are you from?” asks about origin.
“My name is Budi” introduces a name.

questions.prompt: What is your ___? I am Indonesian.
Which sentence has the same meaning as “I am from Indonesia.”?

explanations.en: “I am from Indonesia.” means “My country is Indonesia.”.
explanations.id: “I am from Indonesia.” berarti “My country is Indonesia.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “She is a teacher.”?

explanations.en: “She is a teacher.” means “Her job is teaching.”.
explanations.id: “She is a teacher.” berarti “Her job is teaching.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “We are students.”?

explanations.en: “We are students.” means “We study at a school.”.
explanations.id: “We are students.” berarti “We study at a school.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “Where are you from?”?

explanations.en: “Where are you from?” means “What is your origin?”.
explanations.id: “Where are you from?” berarti “What is your origin?”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “My name is Budi.”?

explanations.en: “My name is Budi.” means “People call me Budi.”.
explanations.id: “My name is Budi.” berarti “People call me Budi.”.

lessons.title: Numbers, age, and time
lessons.objective: Count to ten and talk about age, quantity, and time.

en.title: Numbers, age, and time
en.objective: Count to ten and talk about age, quantity, and time.

blocks.text: Use “I am … years old” for age and “It is … o'clock” for time.

items: Numbers 13–19 end in -teen; multiples of ten end in -ty (thirteen, thirty).

id.title: Angka, usia, dan waktu
id.objective: Berhitung sampai sepuluh dan membicarakan usia, jumlah, dan waktu.

blocks.text: Gunakan “I am … years old” untuk usia dan “It is … o'clock” untuk waktu.

items: Angka 13–19 berakhiran -teen; kelipatan sepuluh berakhiran -ty (thirteen, thirty).

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “I am eighteen years old.”?

explanations.en: “I am eighteen years old.” means “My age is 18.”.
explanations.id: “I am eighteen years old.” berarti “My age is 18.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “She is twenty.”?
Which sentence has the same meaning as “There are three books.”?

explanations.en: “There are three books.” means “The number of books is 3.”.
explanations.id: “There are three books.” berarti “The number of books is 3.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “It is nine o'clock.”?

explanations.en: “It is nine o'clock.” means “The time is 9:00.”.
explanations.id: “It is nine o'clock.” berarti “The time is 9:00.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “I have two cats.”?

explanations.en: “I have two cats.” means “I have 2 cats.”.
explanations.id: “I have two cats.” berarti “I have 2 cats.”.

explanations.en: Use the cardinal number nine for time.
explanations.id: Gunakan angka pokok nine untuk waktu.

lessons.title: Family
lessons.objective: Talk about family members and possession.

en.title: Family
en.objective: Talk about family members and possession.

blocks.text: Add -'s to a person to show possession: my mother's name. Plural nouns take an apostrophe after the s: my parents' house.

items: family — a group of related people
Use “have/has” for family members: I have one sister. She has two brothers.

blocks.text: Tambahkan -'s pada orang untuk menunjukkan kepemilikan: my mother's name. Kata benda jamak memakai apostrof setelah s: my parents' house.

items: Gunakan “have/has” untuk anggota keluarga: I have one sister. She has two brothers.

questions.prompt: Which word means “a group of related people”?

explanations.en: Use the plural brothers after two.
explanations.id: Gunakan bentuk jamak brothers setelah two.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “This is my family.”?

explanations.en: “This is my family.” means “These people are my relatives.”.
explanations.id: “This is my family.” berarti “These people are my relatives.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “My mother is a teacher.”?

explanations.en: “My mother is a teacher.” means “My female parent teaches.”.
explanations.id: “My mother is a teacher.” berarti “My female parent teaches.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “I have two brothers.”?

explanations.en: “I have two brothers.” means “I have 2 male siblings.”.
explanations.id: “I have two brothers.” berarti “I have 2 male siblings.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “She is my sister.”?

explanations.en: “She is my sister.” means “She is my female sibling.”.
explanations.id: “She is my sister.” berarti “She is my female sibling.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “My father is a doctor.”?

choices.label: My male parent works as a doctor.

explanations.en: “My father is a doctor.” means “My male parent works as a doctor.”.
explanations.id: “My father is a doctor.” berarti “My male parent works as a doctor.”.

explanations.en: The sentence says father is a doctor.
Use is with this singular noun.
explanations.id: Gunakan is dengan kata benda tunggal this.

lessons.title: Daily routines
lessons.objective: Describe daily routines in the present simple.

en.title: Daily routines
en.objective: Describe daily routines in the present simple.

blocks.text: Use the present simple for habits. Add -s or -es for he/she/it: she eats, he goes.

items: go — to move to a place
study — to learn about a subject

items.correct: They go to bed at ten.

items: Use “do/does” for questions: Do you study? Does she work?

id.title: Rutinitas harian
id.objective: Mendeskripsikan rutinitas harian dengan present simple.

blocks.text: Gunakan present simple untuk kebiasaan. Tambahkan -s atau -es untuk he/she/it: she eats, he goes.

items.correct: They go to bed at ten.

items: Gunakan “do/does” untuk pertanyaan: Do you study? Does she work?

choices.label: to rest with your eyes closed

explanations.en: “sleep” means “to rest with your eyes closed”.

choices.label: to look at and understand words

explanations.en: “read” means “to look at and understand words”.

choices.label: to make words on paper or screen

explanations.en: “write” means “to make words on paper or screen”.

questions.prompt: Which word means “to take in liquid”?
Which word means “to move to a place”?
Which word means “to learn about a subject”?

explanations.en: Use wake with I in the present simple.
explanations.id: Gunakan wake dengan I pada present simple.

explanations.en: Use the base form with we.
Use the base form with they.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “I wake up at six.”?

choices.label: His job is at a bank.

explanations.en: “I wake up at six.” means “I get up at 6:00.”.
explanations.id: “I wake up at six.” berarti “I get up at 6:00.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “She eats breakfast at seven.”?

choices.label: His job is at a bank.

explanations.en: “She eats breakfast at seven.” means “She has breakfast at 7:00.”.
explanations.id: “She eats breakfast at seven.” berarti “She has breakfast at 7:00.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “We study English every day.”?

choices.label: His job is at a bank.

explanations.en: “We study English every day.” means “We learn English daily.”.
explanations.id: “We study English every day.” berarti “We learn English daily.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “He works at a bank.”?

choices.label: His job is at a bank.

explanations.en: “He works at a bank.” means “His job is at a bank.”.
explanations.id: “He works at a bank.” berarti “His job is at a bank.”.

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as “They go to bed at ten.”?

explanations.en: “They go to bed at ten.” means “They sleep at 10:00.”.
explanations.id: “They go to bed at ten.” berarti “They sleep at 10:00.”.

explanations.en: Use the base form with we.
Use the base form with they.
Use the base form with I.
After do, use the base form.
Use the base form with we.
